newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's San Paolo Spa '96 oper profit up.
newsitem.headline: Italy's San Paolo Spa '96 oper profit up.

text.p: Year ending December 31, 1996 (in billion lire unless stated):

Note - Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino said in a statement the figure was preliminary. It said the 8.5 percent increase in the operating profit took account of the spinoff of its Crediop subsidiary.
It said the increase was due to maintaining interest margins, the positive trend in broking business in securities and in fee income from services.

The bank also said it had benefited from an outstanding performance in its fund management activities and said it was now Italy's top mutual fund manager with a 11.6 percent market share having risen from seventh position the previous year.
